addresses.name: CSendExpeditionCommand_TransferSubtree
addresses.comment: ret 8. CSendExpeditionCommand::Execute's helper (called at 0x1E9C4E, and by itself at 0x1E9906): for each child of parent - leave its parent; clear the expeditionary owner when it equals the target id (taking it off that country's lent list), else set CUnit +0x294 to defines.end_date and, where it had none, make its owner its expeditionary owner (0xE0860); move it from its owner's Units list to the target's (CCountry::AddUnit); attach it back under parent; recurse into its children.

addresses.name: CAIUnit::ManageSubordinates
addresses.comment:
**Slot 78: sorts every unit the agent commands into its per-pass containers and decides which divisions are committed and which held back.** 0x4B1D10 to the bare `ret` at 0x4B32AC; the `bad_alloc` throw tail runs to 0x4B32DF and slot 79 starts at 0x4B32E0. Called from CAIUnit::Tick at 0x4B0A1D when +0x86 replan_subordinates is set, or the hour is (id+9) % 24, or the tick's daily flag is set (hour (id+6) % 24 or +0x84).

(1) Empties the vectors +0x13C, +0x12C, +0x14C, +0x15C, +0x16C, +0x11C, the air list +0xFC (head/tail/count +0xFC/+0x100/+0x104), the vectors +0x10C, +0xDC, +0xEC and +0x1AC, and zeroes +0x348; first it notes whether +0x10C (air transports) was non-empty. (2) The commitment factor from CUnitPlan::GetPowerRatio of the agent's unit: 0.7 above 2.0, 0.6 above 1.5, 0.2 below 0.25, 0.3 below 0.5, 0.4 below 0.75, else 0.5 - all literals. (3) **Walks the whole of the country's unit list (CCountry +0xBAC), not a subtree.** Per unit: clears CUnit +0x2CA; a naval unit under an `invasion` order (0x3A5) has its order's province pushed on +0x1AC whoever owns it; then the unit belongs to this agent when the nearest ai_agent up its parent chain is this one - or it is an air unit whose first brigade is a CAG based on a carrier (home base slot 1) whose fleet's agent is this one. Air: inserted into +0xFC by InsertUnitByRange, and onto +0x10C when its definition's transport_capability is at least 1000. Naval: onto +0xDC, and onto +0xEC when transport_capability >= 1000 and (it carries something, CNavy +0x2EC > 0, or CUnit_FleetNeedsPort answers false). Land: one on `support_attack` (0x4E5) that is neither holding ground nor retreating is stopped (0x49AAB0); onto +0x11C; onto +0x16C when CArmy +0x2FC is 8, and then a CArmy +0x2E4 province whose air base is below level 1 is cleared and CSetAIParamCommand(unit, +0x2E8, 0) posted (0x4B24CB); then, unless slot 86 claims the unit (held_back cleared), a division (oob_level 4) is committed (+0x12C and +0x13C) or held back (+0x15C, CUnit +0x2C8 set) - see FINDINGS-power.md for the strength/organisation bars - and anything else goes on +0x14C. A role-8 division is skipped when air transports existed, and is held back whenever the test runs. With frontier_at_war (+0x364) clear - a frontier at peace, or for a theatre agent's division outside the theatre's largest area, the test is skipped: a held-back division stays held back, any other is committed. A committed division whose destination lies in an area sharing a region group with the capital's area, and on a friendly foreign country's ground (or on enemy ground while it stands on such ground), bumps +0x348 (the arms at 0x4B28B4-0x4B29E9). (4) The reserve size by stance, the recall loop and the detach-to-reserve loop, as FINDINGS-power.md section 'The middle of slot 78'. (5) Clears +0x86. **The one command it posts is CSetAIParamCommand; it detaches nothing and sends no expedition** - those are slot 79's.
